# Generated files are never edited by hand

**Rule.** Fonts, brand logos, pictograms, the boot picture and the time-zone table are regenerated by their script in `firmware/tools/`, never edited by hand.

**Why.** Founder rule: a hand edit is lost at the next generation.

**How.**
- `firmware/main/ui/fonts/*` and the faces: `firmware/tools/make_fonts.py`.
- `firmware/main/ui/brand_logos.c`: `make_brand_logos.py`. `firmware/main/ui/pictos.c`: `make_pictos.py`. `firmware/main/ui/boot_splash.c`: `make_splash.py`. `firmware/main/net/tz_table.h`: `make_tz_table.py`.
- The site's pages are generated at build time (`scripts/make-manifest.py`, `scripts/make-brand-pages.py`) and never committed; their sources are in `installer/`.
